description: The field of building systems that can perform tasks typically requiring human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, and perception.

subdomains.name: Machine Learning
subdomains.description: Algorithms that learn patterns from data to make predictions or decisions without explicit programming.

subdomains.name: Deep Learning
subdomains.description: A subset of machine learning using multi-layered neural networks to model complex patterns.

subdomains.name: NLP
subdomains.description: Natural Language Processing enables machines to understand, generate, and interact using human language.

subdomains.name: Computer Vision
subdomains.description: Enables machines to interpret and process visual information from images and video.

subdomains.name: Robotics AI
subdomains.description: AI techniques applied to perception, planning, and control in physical robots.

subdomains.name: Reinforcement Learning
subdomains.description: Agents learn optimal behavior through trial-and-error interactions with an environment and reward signals.

subdomains.name: Generative AI
subdomains.description: Models that create new content such as text, images, audio, or code from learned patterns.

subdomains.name: Multi-Agent Systems
subdomains.description: Systems where multiple AI agents interact, cooperate, or compete to achieve goals.

subdomains.name: AI Safety
subdomains.description: Research focused on ensuring AI systems behave reliably, predictably, and without unintended harm.

subdomains.name: AI Ethics
subdomains.description: Examines fairness, bias, accountability, and societal impact of AI systems.
